So I was dual booting Linux Mint and Windows 10 together and decided to remove Linux Mint. Now whenever I try to boot up my computer Grub goes into rescue mode saying no partition found. Does anyone know how to fix this?
Problem booting into Windows 10 with Grub

Does your grub rescue mode bring you to a grub shell? If so, try this

set root=(hd0,msdos1)
chainloader +1
boot

Replace msdos1 with whatever your partition number is. (Tab-completion should word in grub.) Once you're in windows, open an administrative command prompt by clicking start, typing cmd, right clicking on command prompt, choosing open as administrator, and clicking yes. After the command prompt loads, type in

Bootrec.exe /FixMbr

This all is supposing that you have a BIOS based system. If your system is UEFI based, then this might not work for you at all.
